name: Monetary transmission / financial conditions contract

objectSeparation.POLICY_STANCE: policy-rate level, administered rates and balance-sheet stance; not identical to financial conditions
objectSeparation.POLICY_SURPRISE: difference between policy action/communication and pre-event expectation, requiring authentic expectation vintage
objectSeparation.MARKET_REACTION: post-announcement rates/equity/FX/credit moves; mediator/outcome for earlier decision clocks
objectSeparation.FINANCIAL_CONDITIONS: joint state of rates, credit spreads, equities, FX, housing and related financial variables
objectSeparation.BANK_CREDIT_STANDARDS: bank underwriting/terms from SLOOS; partly distinct from traded-market prices
objectSeparation.GROWTH_IMPULSE: estimated future-growth effect from a model such as FCI-G; model output, not directly observed condition

NFCI.semantics: weekly broad statistical index of 105 money/debt-equity/banking measures; positive values indicate tighter-than-average conditions under its normalization
NFCI.ANFCI: adjusts financial conditions for prevailing economic activity/inflation
NFCI.revisionGuard: history can revise as underlying data revise and factor weights update

FCI_G.semantics: model-based estimate of how changes in selected financial variables affect one-year-ahead GDP growth through dynamic multipliers
FCI_G.interpretation: positive/headwind versus negative/tailwind under the published FCI-G convention
FCI_G.endogeneityGuard: Fed note explicitly treats financial-variable changes as if exogenous for decomposition even though in reality they respond to macro/policy news
FCI_G.coverageGuard: does not fully capture all credit channels such as bank lending standards

SLOOS.semantics: survey of bank lending standards/terms and loan demand; credit-supply/demand context distinct from market-price FCI
SLOOS.frequencyGuard: quarterly survey timing and reference period differ from daily/weekly market variables

redundancyFirewall: NFCI/FCI-G composite must be tested after their own underlying rates/equity/USD/credit components.
A composite that adds no value beyond components is descriptive only.
Do not include composite plus identical components in one score without explicit collinearity/redundancy handling.
Policy surprise cannot be reconstructed from later market prices.
falsification: policy rate unchanged but financial conditions materially move
financial conditions loosen/tighten before policy decision via expectations
NFCI vs ANFCI vs FCI-G disagreement treated as model/context evidence, not data error
SLOOS added after traded-market financial conditions to test bank-credit increment

maturityDecision.reason: Policy/market/credit objects, official index semantics, revision/endogeneity limits, Taiwan transmission and redundancy/falsification are frozen; no prospective Taiwan incremental evidence for L3.

exactNext: Capture official NFCI/ANFCI and FCI-G vintages with publishedAt/capturedAt/revision semantics.
Build component-only baseline before any composite financial-conditions feature.
Preserve SLOOS as separate lower-frequency credit-state object.
Test risk/MAE/gap outcomes before direction once source-attested dates exist.
